program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (objs (objects-8 g 0))
                (stays (cellmap g
                                (r c v)
                                (let ((orig v))
                                  (if (zero? orig)
                                      0
                                      (let ((my-obj (find (lambda (o)
                                                            (for/or ((cell (obj-cells o)))
                                                                    (and
                                                                      (= (fst cell) r)
                                                                      (= (snd cell) c))))
                                                          objs)))
                                        (if my-obj
                                            (let ((bb (obj-bbox my-obj)))
                                              (if (or (= r (nth bb 2)) (= c (nth bb 3)))
                                                  1
                                                  0))
                                            0)))))))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (let* ((orig v)
                           (shifted (if (and
                                          (> c 0)
                                          (!= (at g r (- c 1)) 0)
                                          (zero? (at stays r (- c 1))))
                                        (at g r (- c 1))
                                        0))
                           (is-stay (and (!= orig 0) (= (at stays r c) 1))))
                      (cond (is-stay orig) ((!= shifted 0) shifted) (else 0)))))))
